facts.fact: The report says the PDM Information System registers eligible beneficiaries, the Integrated Financial Management Information System transfers funds to PDM SACCO accounts, and Wendi, managed by Pearl Bank, disburses loans to beneficiaries' mobile phones, with 183,430 of 222,389 enterprise groups profiled on PDMIS; as_of is the published date, the document giving no event date.
